boundaryPolicy.basis: The Journal's published paid and IFP counts define the snapshot-cohort ranges.
boundaryPolicy.calendarDateCaveat: The official public docket contains same-cutoff-date records above those count-defined ranges, so this cohort is not every public docket carrying the cutoff calendar date.

notes: The official Journal reports 1,327 paid and 2,527 IFP cases docketed during OT2024.
The official published counts define the benchmark ranges 24-1 through 24-1327 and 24-5001 through 24-7527; same-day dockets above those count boundaries are recorded separately as exclusions.
The extract is a closed docketed-intake cohort, not a census of submissions that were never docketed.
Docket-visible response, CFR, CVSG, amicus, relist, disposition, and merits-follow-through fields are coded where applicable.
Rows already present in the same-date official-docket Journal-detail extract may be reused to avoid redundant Court-site requests; the manifest reports reused and freshly fetched counts.
Specialist-counsel, former-clerk, alleged-split, genuine-split, split-depth, issue-area, and vehicle-quality fields remain outside this automated source slice.
sourceName: Official Supreme Court OT2024 published-statistics paid/IFP docketed-intake cohort
